Container.Name: PriceBuddy
Container.Overview: PriceBuddy tracks product prices across stores and tells you when they drop. This package runs it as one container: the app, its database and the headless Chrome scraper it needs for sites like Amazon. Updates arrive through Check for Updates, with the release notes.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The only port this app publishes.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Database, settings and generated secrets. Small; put it on a fast pool and back it up.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address you open PriceBuddy at, e.g. https://prices.example.com. Links in notifications are built from it.

Config.Name: Admin email
Config.Description: The first user's login, created on first start only.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Optional, first start only. Left empty, one is generated and saved in secrets.env in the app data folder.

Config.Name: Store country
Config.Description: Which built-in stores to create on first start: usa, australia or all.

Config.Name: Affiliate links
Config.Description: Upstream's default. true adds the author's affiliate tag to some store links, which supports the project at no cost to you.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for the price check schedule.
